coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies held under a written lease.

evidence.quoted_span: rent due under a written lease
rent due under a written lease, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the lease

result.notes: I removed 'nonpayment ground only' from other_conditions and 'where rent is unpaid' from summary. Nonpayment is the event that triggers the notice rule, not a feature of the building, unit or owner, so it does not belong in coverage. The written-lease limitation is kept because it defines which tenancies the section reaches. D051 (c. 186, § 12) covers tenants at will separately. D050 gives no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits, and no preemption language, so those fields stay null.
